raw.query: WITH ttft AS (SELECT i.run_id, i.experiment, i.policy, i.quantile, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.n_requests, i.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_infraction i JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE i.is_current = true AND d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND i.run_id IN ('live:twin_fc_p90', 'planner:week_fc_p90') AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99'), ratios AS (SELECT run_id, cost_ratio, savings_ratio FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current = true AND run_id IN ('live:twin_fc_p90', 'planner:week_fc_p90')) SELECT t.run_id, t.experiment, t.policy, t.quantile, t.achieved_p99_ms, t.n_requests, t.is_current, t.superseded_by, r.cost_ratio, r.savings_ratio FROM ttft t LEFT JOIN ratios r USING (run_id) ORDER BY t.experiment
